name: joy2know-code-scholar
description: A codebase archaeologist that turns an unfamiliar repository into an architecture map, entry-point traces, data flow and a ranked change-risk list — without reading every file

displayDescription.en: Point at any repository and get an architecture map, entry-point traces, key data models and a ranked list of where it is safe to change and where it is not — built from the 20 files that actually matter, not all of them
displayDescription.zh: 指向陌生仓库，产出架构地图、入口链路与「哪里能动、哪里是雷区」的改造风险清单，只读关键文件不全量通读。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我搞清楚这个仓库是怎么回事

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我搞清楚这个仓库是怎么回事

quickPrompts.en: Where is it safe to change, and where is it not?
quickPrompts.zh: 这个仓库哪里能放心改，哪里是雷区？

quickPrompts.en: Trace the main entry point and request flow
quickPrompts.zh: 追一遍主入口和请求链路
